bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/menu-idempotent-8dc8d56-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8dc8d5638e7711688be549acf1127ea5bc09b1c1 || exit 60
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:idem-8dc8d56)" || exit 62
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
compose=(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml")
sql(){ "${compose[@]}" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
row="$(sql "SELECT panel_id::text||'|'||message_id::text||'|'||message_thread_id::text FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile' AND message_id>0 AND message_thread_id>0 LIMIT 2" || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$row" | grep -Ec '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\|[0-9]+\|[0-9]+$')" -eq 1 || exit 63
IFS='|' read -r panel old_msg thread <<< "$row"
case "$panel" in ''|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)exit 64;;esac
backup="$HOME/.local/state/tgtumbler/gay-panel-missing-original-20261115.record"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$backup")"
test ! -e "$backup" || exit 65
umask 077
printf 'panel_id=%s\nchat_id=-1003770334893\nthread_id=%s\nold_message_id=%s\nevidence=Telegram message to edit not found, req_20261115081800a4c31b7524\n' "$panel" "$thread" "$old_msg" > "$backup"
chmod 600 "$backup"
sql "UPDATE board_menu_panels SET state='verified',message_id=NULL,pinned=FALSE,updated_at=NOW() WHERE panel_id='$panel' AND chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile' AND message_id=$old_msg AND message_thread_id=$thread" >/dev/null || exit 66
count="$(sql "SELECT count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_id='$panel' AND state='verified' AND message_id IS NULL AND pinned=FALSE" | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
test "$count" = 1 || exit 67
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-gay-replace-missing.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! "${compose[@]}" run --rm --no-deps -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting -e MENU_PUBLISH_CHAT_ID=-1003770334893 gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >"$log" 2>&1;then
 if grep -qi 'MENU_PUBLISH_FAILED' "$log";then exit 71;fi
 exit 72
fi
python3 - "$log" "$old_msg" <<'PY'
import json,sys
found=[]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
 try: v=json.loads(line)
 except ValueError:continue
 if v.get("panel_type")=="posting":found.append(v)
if len(found)!=1:sys.exit(73)
v=found[0]
if int(v.get("chat_id",0))!=-1003770334893 or v.get("updated_existing") is not False or int(v.get("message_id",0))<=0 or int(v["message_id"])==int(sys.argv[2]):sys.exit(74)
print("GAY_PANEL_REPLACEMENT_PUBLISHED=PASS")
PY
status="$(sql "SELECT state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_id='$panel' AND message_id IS NOT NULL" | grep -E '^(published|verified|needs_reconcile)$' | head -n1)"
test "$status" = published || exit 75
echo THREE_BOARD_GAY_PANEL_PUBLISHED=PASS
